phase: Complete Inbound Insurance Queue Read Path
objective: Remove the generic 50-record relationship cohort as the completeness boundary for insurance operational triage while preserving the existing all-relationships CRM view.

architecture.insuranceQueueRead: Dedicated profile-backed relationship reader using immutable created_at keyset pagination.
architecture.finalOrdering: INS-006X updatedAt DESC then relationshipId ASC.

paging.continuation: created_at < cursor.createdAt OR created_at = cursor.createdAt AND relationship_id > cursor.relationshipId

dataBoundary: Only relationships with a canonical river_crm_insurance_lead_profiles row are enumerated by the dedicated queue reader.
existingPerformanceIndex: Migration 0008 defines created_at DESC, relationship_id ASC but remains unexecuted.
invariants: Generic River CRM list() default 50 behavior is unchanged.
All relationships view continues to use the generic CRM cohort.
Insurance queue counts and filtered cohorts use the complete insurance queue cohort.
Pure INS-006X triage rules remain authoritative.
No triage business rule is duplicated in SQL.
No N+1 relationship reads are introduced.
No lead score or automatic producer routing is introduced.
No schema or migration file is changed.
